g.text: Held-out queries: XML, CSV, and dialogue; macro average across three correlated views per fact.
Held-out observations: one of those three formats per fact, in a mixed bank. Development-selected checkpoints; one training seed (42); uncertainty not shown.
Matched LM examples and update budgets; prompt lengths and consistency computation differ. Synthetic 16-word vocabulary; no claim of general natural-language transfer.
